## About
Time Out Tavern is a cozy local sports bar on W Lovers Ln in Dallas, with walls full of memorabilia, a pool table, shuffleboard, darts and a rear patio. We call it a sports dive, and we mean that kindly.
We pour domestic classics, local and craft beers and imports, plus vodka, tequila, gin, whiskey, wine and even champagne. We don't cook, but you're welcome to bring your own food or order delivery from nearby restaurants. Just ask us for the menus.
Guests have given us a 4.2 rating from 182 Google reviews. Come watch the game with us.

## Services
- Beer: Domestic classics, local and craft beers, and imports.
- Balcones, vodka, tequila and gin: Three varieties of Balcones, plus a good selection of vodka, tequila, gin and whisk(e)y.
- Wine and champagne: Red and white wine, and champagne when the occasion calls for it.
- Happy hour: Happy hour every day until 7:00 PM.
- Nightly specials: Nightly specials Sunday through Thursday until 10 PM.
- Shots: Fireball, Tuaca and Rumpleminze shots for $5 and Jello shots for $1, all the time.
- Pool table, shuffle board and darts: A pool table, shuffle board and darts inside, with a patio out back.

## FAQ
Q: Do you serve food?
A: Not officially. We have a few frozen snacks for less than $5 that you can heat up in our microwave, and you're welcome to bring your own food or order delivery. We keep menus for a lot of the nearby restaurants.

Q: Are dogs allowed on the patio?
A: We're sorry, but we don't have the permits for dogs on the premises. Only service animals are allowed.

Q: Are you showing the big pay-per-view event?
A: Probably not. The licensing fees for a bar are pretty high and we'd have to charge a cover. Give us a call if you want to be sure.
